steps.name: Today Is the Day
steps.objective: Find [Lena Hyren] in the "Silver Shield Tavern".

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Right on time. I'll deliver Her Majesty's decree now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Here. The seal will disappear as soon as you touch it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right.
(Just as Lena said, the seal melts away the moment you touch the document.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How fascinating.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: One of the Imperial Magic Bureau's patented techniques. The seal is made using the recipient's information... Only the intended recipient can open it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how do they enter that information? How do they know who I am...?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I don't know the details of the bureau's work. Now, read Her Majesty's message.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Let's see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: 'Dear messenger of the goddess. The power you and your goddess need lies in Moros.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: 'Find the siblings who have brought suffering to Freios and Eastland, and you will draw closer to the truth.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's Ban and Mara...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: 'Empress of the Silvaria Empire—Kaina Dawn Silvaria...'

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: (It's been a while since I heard Her Majesty's full name...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena, what am I supposed to do now?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Whether you follow Her Majesty's wishes is up to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's an imperial order. Do you think I can disobey it?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Hehe. Decide for yourself. For the details, enter Esnil, the center of the Guild Union city, and meet Director Dayna.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: She'll tell you what to do. I'll be off, then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, Lena... She's gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The power we need... I can't keep this to myself. Iris...? Iris, are you listening? Could we talk for a moment?
(Iris's faint image appears before %s.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes... I'm here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Iris about your conversation with Lena.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I can't tell exactly, but I sense a strong power there. I don't know whether it belongs to a Champion, but I do think someone is there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll have to go and see for myself... There are things I want to find out, too.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: All right... I'm counting on you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Please be careful. Then I'll...
(Iris's image vanishes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't wor—

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I was going to tell her not to worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh well. Time to go...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena said someone named Dayna would know. I'd better head inside.

steps.name: Reasonable Doubt
steps.objective: Defeat [Letum] in the "Warriors' Rest" and obtain the <Records of the Twisted One>. Then report to [Raclette] in "Esnil".

lines.text: (Esnil, the central district of the Guild Union city. A woman of refined bearing stands before a tower that appears to be the union's headquarters.)
(The woman examines what looks like a stack of paperwork, then sighs.)
Sigh. Things got complicated while I was away for a moment... My sister again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me. Are you Director Dayna?
Hm?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena sent me.
Oh, it's you. I've been waiting. Dame Lena told me about you. You work for the goddess. Your name is %s, right?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sorry for the late introduction. I'm Dayna, director of the Guild Union and master of the Storm Watchers Guild.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Storm Watchers Guild? That's Einst's...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, exactly. Thank you for taking care of all the things Einst asked of you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was nothing, Director.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'd rather you used my name than my title. I'm not fond of formality.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, Director Day— I mean, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Good. Then I'll call you %s as well. Is that all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's fine. Let's get to the point.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lena told me to see you... But what am I supposed to do next?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Her Majesty has approved you, and you've received permission to enter Esnil, but...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're unsure because you don't know what sort of person I am.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, exactly. I start by being suspicious of anyone I haven't dealt with myself. Otherwise, how can I know?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's only natural, so don't take it personally.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm the same way. I don't really know what sort of person you are either. So what can we do to earn each other's trust?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hehe. Thank you for being direct. Then I should give you a reason to trust me first, %s.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Would this suffice?
(Dayna takes a black card from inside her coat.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Once I sign this card and you authenticate your magic with the Infinite Corridor's help, %s...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You'll receive every privilege the Empire offers, including those of Esnil, the Guild Union city.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You'll officially be someone recognized by Empress Kaina of the Silvaria Empire.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: In return, %s, show 'us' what you can do. Nothing is more convincing than a demonstration of skill.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, us. 'Moonlight.' You don't need the details, so don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There's a job I've assigned to Raclette. Go with him. He'll report what he sees there, and you can prove yourself that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it difficult?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It could be difficult, or easy, depending on how you look at it. Now, Raclette.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Relax that expression.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Director, I'm feeling perfectly relaxed right now...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I've seen that expression for years, and I'm still not used to it.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Then we just need to go there and retrieve the item?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An item?)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It might be difficult alone, so take %s with you. After all, the presence of the dead still lingers there.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Understood. Let's go, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where are we going?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: To Mirgandia, first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First...?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: It may be somewhere you know, but it will be different when you go with me. Come along.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right... Let's go, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does he mean, a place I know that will be different when I go with him...?)

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Well done. We also obtained what we needed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: What are you thinking so hard about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been there before, but... something was different today. As though we'd entered another space...

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: So you sensed it clearly. Someone chosen by a goddess really is different...

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Though we're different from other people too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean by different?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Director Dayna will explain that. In any case, I've felt true divine power now, and that's enough...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I've earned your trust?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Your abilities were excellent. Once I send you back, the director will handle things. Take this book to her while you're there...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Oh, this book... You found it there?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Yes. Among the dead...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I couldn't find anything like it before. Why did it appear when I went with you?

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Even the same world has different facets. We're fortunate enough to see one of them and enter it... I'll only say that it's distorted.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: I need to sort out the shipments that piled up while we were away. Go straight to the director. She'll be waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. But what's this cake here? It looks delicious.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Zellic left another cake. What a bother... Oh, do you like desserts?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's tasty, I like it.

lines.speaker: 라클렛
lines.text: Perfect. Take all of it. I'll be off...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait, Raclette. This is far too much! He's gone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. Then I'd better see Dayna.

steps.name: A Place of New Destiny (1)
steps.objective: Defeat [Mose Kingdom Knights] and [Red Hildisvini] in "Moros". Then report to [Aurum] in "Moros".

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You're back, %s?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Surely you haven't come empty-handed?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. We found a book there and brought it back.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you. 'We' needed this, but it simply wouldn't turn up. It's been quite a struggle.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Then you appeared, and thanks to you, we were able to find it. I'm truly grateful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This... wasn't Guild Union business, was it?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Correct. Now put that suspicious look aside for a moment. I'll explain everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Do you know something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Know what?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The world is enveloped in darkness as well as light. But people remember only the light, and believe that light alone is the truth.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Light and darkness are both parts of the world. In fact, every existence has a truth of its own.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Darkness welcomes the light and holds the truth that grants rest to all. Yet at some point, the world began to fear any place where darkness gathered thickly.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Wicked people exploited that darkness until they made it 'evil.' There is darkness that isn't evil, yet even that was denied...
(Waves of darkness flow from Dayna's fingertips. They rise around her, then vanish.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna, what is this...?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hehe. Call it proof of an existence that was denied. I only show it to people I can trust. You must have a secret or two yourself, don't you?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Memories, for instance...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you know, Dayna? And how?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: My sister only gave me a hint. Looks like I guessed right. It was just a shot in the dark, so don't worry too much about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your sister...?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You'll meet her when the time comes. Anyway, our power startled you a little, didn't it? It's only slightly distorted. Don't be afraid.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I wasn't that startled. Things like this happen around me so often that I just accept them now.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Hehe. You're an interesting person. Here, take this card. With it, you've become a little more special.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Dayna. What should I do now?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There's somewhere you need to go now, %s. You may already know it: Moros, in Eastland, where the allied forces are stationed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Moros? Could this be connected to the Kingdom of Moss?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Exactly. Explaining it here could take a while. Go there, deal with whatever needs dealing with along the way, and meet the Savior.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: They'll tell you what's happening there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. How do I get there?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Go to the Void Sea, and you'll see an Imperial Gate. The Infinite Corridor mages built it by imperial order.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I see. I'll be going, then.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, %s. Have a good trip.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A trip... meaning I should come back once the work there is done? Is that Her Majesty's wish too?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Perhaps it is. Hehe. Don't worry about that. See what's in front of you first. And cut down anything that gets in your way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (First, I'll deal with Moros.)

steps.name: A Place of New Destiny (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Mose Kingdom Mages] and [Tuxedo Schrodingers] in "Moros". Then report to [Aurum] in "Moros".

lines.text: (In the distance, a Savior carrying an unusual weapon comes into view. Defeated enemies and strange creatures lie all around them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that the Savior Dayna mentioned...? Impressive. They handled all those enemies...
Who's there?
Oh, you're %s... Her Majesty told me about you. I'm Aurum, a Savior, as you can see.
(The outfit has a different feel from Platina's Holy Order uniform. The weapon also radiates a sacred presence.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Aurum... Though with that weapon, I couldn't really tell you were a Savior. A club with a sacred aura...?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: You really are different. Hardly anyone has sensed that power in this blunt weapon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels just like Lapier...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's like the energy of the land where Goddess Gaia stayed.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Then perhaps it was made from a sacred tree there. A weapon perfectly suited to someone bearing a sacred duty, like me.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Sending enemies flying into the distance really is the best fun.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. Aurum, I don't think this is the time for that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There seem to be an awful lot of enemies here. Will you be all right alone?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I can manage alone, but it would take a while, so I'd appreciate your help. Give me the chance to fight alongside the Goddess's Executioner.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can have all the chances you like, but please forget that title. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I think it's an honorable title... In any case, you should see a blunt-weapon Savior rampage, just as Her Majesty ordered.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I'll do my best. Please take that side, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Wait—what did you say you were going to do? Rampage?

steps.name: The Etoile Alliance
steps.objective: Find [Platina] in front of the "Magical Fallout Shelter" in "Moros".

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Well done. Wait a moment...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: You sensed it too, %s. An evil power... This must be...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Magic stones... For the feeling to be this strong, it can't be just a few of them...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: If they aren't ordinary magic stones, they must belong to those two.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know them too, Aurum?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes. Ban and Mara... And the Kingdom of Moss, which the siblings have empowered. The allied forces are putting their strength into this, so it should be over soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you explain these allied forces?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dayna said the Savior would tell me about them.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Oh, I see. Then I'd better explain.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: The Sanctuary has been watching events in Freios and the other continents for some time.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Awakening dormant places, exploiting the greedy, using a peaceful people to attack another country...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: There were people committing all kinds of evil. They called themselves Agasuras, but witnesses said something about them was different.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Once Her Majesty confirmed this, she immediately ordered their defeat. But she didn't merely intend to capture them...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: She sent envoys to gather various powers, intending to erase their ally, the Kingdom of Moss, from history as well.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: From Jiendia came members of the ancient Jiendia Empire and the Kingdom of Elias. From Freios came the Silvaria Empire and the Libera Free Alliance...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: From Eastland came the Kingdom of Jude and the Alliance of Light. All these powers have joined forces against the Kingdom of Moss.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: With that much strength, it seems like you could finish off the Deimos cult too.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I couldn't say. Right now, the allied forces' objective is to bring the Kingdom of Moss to an end here in Moros.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Members of the various powers are deployed throughout Moros. I have my own assigned mission as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your mission... Is it all right for me to know about it, Aurum?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Of course. Her Majesty personally told me my mission was to rampage around the battlefield as usual.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I still can't begin to imagine what kind of person this empress is...)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: You should go see my junior, Platina, now, %s. She's tracking the magic stones' power, but I doubt she can handle it alone.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Her Majesty said the same thing: Platina would need you, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then it must be over that way...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: A place called the Magical Fallout Shelter. Go to its entrance. Platina should be waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Aurum. Then I'll...

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes. I'll keep taking down the enemies here!
(Before the words are even out, Aurum leaps into the midst of the enemies.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a person. Still, I feel I'll be visiting the Sanctuary someday... I wonder how Platina is doing. I'd better hurry.

steps.name: Dreaming Greed
steps.objective: Defeat [Prince Nox] in the "Magical Fallout Shelter", then report to [Platina] in "Moros".

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Sigh. Is there no way to get inside?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: (I can feel a strong power approaching... Either Aurum or the adventurer, surely...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Platina, why are you here alone?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Adventurer, you're here. If you've come this far, you must have met Director Dayna. And Aurum, too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I received Her Majesty's decree...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly tell Platina about your time in Esnil and your meeting with Aurum.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So how are things here?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: As the allied forces seized the Kingdom of Moss's strongholds, various towns and factions surrendered. The kingdom's end is close now.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: But its greedy prince refuses to give up. He's supplied his loyal knights and mages with magic stones.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait. If I can feel the stones' ominous power this strongly...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes, adventurer. There's an enormous quantity inside. Over there, in the place called the Magical Fallout Shelter.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It was originally a safe haven built by war-weary villagers to protect themselves. Now Prince Nox has led his remaining soldiers inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Prince Nox is the prince of Moss?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes. He apparently planned to use Ban and Mara to become a conqueror of the continent. When things failed to go his way, he even forced his father, King Void, to step down.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: The allied forces captured King Void and tried to persuade Prince Nox to surrender, but he kept holding out in the shelter.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Then a mage emerged, killed King Void, and defeated half the allied troops here with a power unlike anything we'd seen before.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: It was the magic stones. They're wielding dozens, hundreds of them. Their power is truly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. What a headache.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I heard you defeated a man named Randaine in Tartaros. Unlike Randaine, who was consumed by the stones, Prince Nox overcame their influence himself.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: ...If only I could get inside, I would fight him...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean? Why can't you go inside, Platina?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: There's a barrier. The allied mages combined their power, but we still weren't allowed through.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Perhaps this is why Her Majesty brought you here, %s. Adventurer, please go inside and bring Prince Nox down.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: You should be able to enter and reach him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd almost rather have come here without hearing all this. It's left a bad taste in my mouth.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is Her Majesty thinking? No, what kind of person is she? Suddenly I feel like a chess piece—and so does everyone here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't need to apologize, Platina. All of this... No. Someday, I want to meet Her Majesty and ask her myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just as there are things I want to ask Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much. If this is all destined to happen, I'll win. I'll be going, then.

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: I sent my elite knights and mages against you, yet here you stand before me. Impressive. You have my praise. Now, what is your name?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want to know?

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: How insolent. Who do you think I am? I am...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shut up. You're the insolent one. Whoever you are, there's no denying the harm you've done to the world. So many people have bled because of you. Do you understand?

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: This is for a greater cause. My will shall be etched into Freios, beyond this land. Nothing can be accomplished in this accursed place.

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: History will recognize one who does great things.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you think that power is truly yours? Born a prince, wielding false strength from magic stones... Don't delude yourself!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Fine. I'll give you credit for one thing: you haven't been consumed by the stones.

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: A compliment? Then I shall thank you. Being consumed is a fate fit only for the weak. I have no need of such a process.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll make you regret saying that. I doubt you'd care about my name even if I told you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. Shall we make a promise? If I defeat you, I'll tell you. This is where the wicked prince scoffs and says that will never happen, right?

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: How vulgar, to spout such trite words. I am not weak. And I will do anything to restore the glory of the Kingdom of Moss.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. Shall we begin, then? This may be destined, but I won't let you have your way!

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: Guh...
(Magic stones filled with sinister power shatter and fall from Prince Nox's clothing.)

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: I thought these stones would make my dream come true. Was I wrong...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You, him, everyone... Why are you all so obsessed with this kind of power?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm destined to win? Then why does victory have to be this hard?

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: ...You know something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know. I don't want to know, and I don't want to tell you anything. But I'll keep my promise. My name is %s...

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: Cough... cough... Yes, I've heard that name. The divine messenger who thwarted everything Ban and Mara did and saved the Kingdom of Jude...

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: Why must you interfere at every turn?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Your grip tightens around your weapon. So tightly that you feel ready to hurt someone at any moment...)

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: You're going to kill me...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I'll kill y—

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait. I...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't intend to kill you. I was only going to defeat you, hand you over to the allied forces, and leave. S-something's wrong...

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: Hahahaha! Cough... So that's it, is it? Ahahaha! 'Divine messenger' is merely a flattering name. You're a puppet all the same... Cough...

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: Those who received divine power and followed the gods in this world destroyed themselves. You will too. The Night of the Witches won't leave you alone. And my will shall remain to curse you, again and again...

lines.speaker: 녹스 왕자
lines.text: Hahahaha... Heh, hehehe... Gaaaaaaaah! Aaaaaah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Huh?
(Prince Nox, his face twisted with resentment, suddenly collapses in agony. As a side effect of the magic stones, his arms and legs begin turning to dust, one by one.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this how he ends...? Oh... the allied forces?
(Allied mages rush in and use healing magic to stop Prince Nox from disintegrating. They bind him and drag him away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was destined to defeat an enemy, and that's all I did... But I don't feel any better.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. I'd better go to Platina...
(After the fierce battle with Prince Nox ends, someone slowly emerges from the back of the seemingly empty chamber.)

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Damn it. Even Nox couldn't deal with that pest. Is this the end of the Kingdom of Moss...?

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Why are you just standing there in a daze?

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: N-nothing. Do we have any magic stones left? We'll need at least those if we're going to do anything.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: The device we installed a few days ago has activated. We can hold out there. Let's go to Oneiro...

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: What about its guardian?

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: If everything's gone as planned, it will have taken a different form by now. Once that pest steps inside, it's all over.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Let's finish things here and return to Freios. We'll wipe out those Silvarian bastards all over again.

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: I don't know anymore. What we're doing with these stones...

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Shut up. Think of everything the Silvaria Empire put us through.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Come on. Let's watch that pest's life come to an end.

steps.name: As Foreseen
steps.objective: Find [Jin] in front of [Dreaming Oneiro] in "Moros".

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: You're back. With this, the Kingdom of Moss...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said only I could get inside. When did the allied soldiers get in?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: The barrier began weakening as you defeated the mages carrying magic stones. We took that opening and approached as closely as we could.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then once Prince Nox's stones shattered, you were able to reach him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Platina, you must know what I'm supposed to do now. I know I was sent here to finish this job.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not blaming you. Just tell me where I need to go.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: You need to go to Oneiro Forest. It's at the farthest reaches of Moros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Once I'm there, I'll know what to do.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes. Someone you know will be waiting there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Oh, what happens to the war now?

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: We've captured Prince Nox and all the remaining soldiers. The Kingdom of Moss officially no longer exists.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Lord Ziskad, leader of the Alliance of Light, will oversee the Moros region from now on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That was quick. Then I'd better make sure I finish my part properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry for making you uncomfortable, Platina. I'll be going now. See you later.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes. Please be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry. I've always managed well enough.

lines.speaker: 플라티나
lines.text: Yes, adventurer.

steps.name: Work to Do in the Forest
steps.objective: Defeat [Bergelmir] in "Dreaming Oneiro" and obtain <Bergelmir's Heart Fragment>. Then report to [Jin] in "Moros".

lines.text: (As you head farther in, you hear a familiar voice. Someone seems to be confronting an enemy.)

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Damn it. I thought there'd be no one guarding Oneiro Forest...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: So you were the ones who caused the explosion.

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Explosion?

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Oh, good. Right on schedule. Now, in there... No, first I'll deal with this warrior from a fallen kingdom.
(Ban takes something from his pocket and throws it toward Jin. An unknown power flows from the object at Jin's feet.)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Urgh... cough... What is this...? Don't tell me... You bastards, what have you done...? I can't move...

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Stay quiet and die here, meddler. This magic stone is still experimental, but for the likes of you...
(Jin struggles, unable to move. Power from the magic stone rises slowly around him.)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: This is... a binding...
(With a satisfied look, Ban hurries into Oneiro Forest with Mara.)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: To end so meaninglessly... I haven't even had my revenge...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not yet. Don't give up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You raise your weapon and destroy the binding energy holding Jin.)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Cough... cough...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Whew... Thank you. Thank you for freeing me from that binding. But how could you release me from that power...?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: (Ah. The texture of that power is different from before...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The power of binding... You know about it too.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: We'll discuss that later. Something dangerous is happening in the forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is what I need to do. Please, tell me.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: This forest is called Oneiro. The Kingdom of Moss considered it ominous and restricted access. Supposedly, a guardian deity drives away or punishes anyone with wicked intentions...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: My scouts and I went in several times, but we kept losing our way and had to come back out.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Then there was a tremendous explosion... The scouts used that opening to investigate.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: They said the village and forest had exploded, leaving strange traces, and the people had transformed horribly...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: We tried to go back and see for ourselves, but some power was already preventing us from entering. We were dragged back outside.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Traces of the Moss army were mixed with an unknown force. I sent someone to the allied forces and was watching the situation when...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: The ones behind the magic stones arrived. Those red-haired siblings...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The forest's energy is certainly different from elsewhere. Almost like a curse... I'll go. I should be able to resolve this.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Why are you so certain?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I don't at least believe that, I won't be able to do anything.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: All right. I understand. Go and do what only you can do. I'll do my part here and wait for you.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Oh, when things are settled, bring me something that will help explain what happened inside.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. And once this is over, let's discuss the rest over a cup of tea.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: All right... I'll be waiting...
(Deep within Oneiro Forest, you find Ban and Mara in hiding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You wretched bastards. I've finally found you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This horrifying scene is your doing, isn't it? People imprisoned in magic stones, that girl transformed into something strange...

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Partly right, partly wrong. What I can say for certain is that you're about to regret coming here.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: There's a being here that hates people like you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?
(Something crashes down ahead with a thunderous roar. It is so enormous that its shadow seems to cover the entire forest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cough... cough... What is that? A golem?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A strange monster made of stone, machinery, and plants mixed together...)
'Kshh... kshh... Reboot...'
'Activating...'
'Codename: Bergelmir...'
(An artificial-sounding voice echoes throughout the forest. It seems to belong to the golem that identified itself as Bergelmir.)

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'Explosion mode unlocked.'

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'System access.'

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'Preparing to reset planet Etoile... This process cannot be canceled without administrator authorization...'

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: What does 'reset' mean?

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: No idea. It doesn't matter to us. The guardian can't touch us or the stones we made. You saw that.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: He said that's how it would work, so it must be right. At least he hasn't given us any wrong information yet.

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: That's true. That man... Still, having to do what he says...
(Ban and Mara stare intently toward Bergelmir.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's with those two...? Sigh. Do I just have to fight...? W-wait. What's happening...?
(Suddenly, time seems to stop. Bergelmir, as well as Ban and Mara hiding in the distance, all freeze.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: ...Adventurer. I'm glad I reached you before your battle with Bergelmir... Fortunately, this place is part of the domain I can access...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you do that?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: That isn't important now... A brief explanation... Oneiro belongs to another region of space-time... I was able to impose a temporary override...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Weapons like Bergelmir are what destroyed the world in another timeline...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Bergelmir's heart... Destroy its heart, and it should stop moving...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If you want to know more about it, destroy it and visit my room.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: And please be careful...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sarasvati...
(Sarasvati disappears. Time seems to resume, and Bergelmir begins moving again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...So that's the monster that brought about the bad ending...?

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'Bergelmir is initiating the reset of planet Etoile.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bergelmir, was it? Whatever happens, I'm taking you down right here. That's my goal now.

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'Interference detected... The interfering entity will be included in the reset. Consent will be presumed. Proceeding... Rooooar!'
(Bergelmir stops moving as cracks spread across its heart. Its eyes, once fixated on destruction, gradually change, almost seeming kind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did I get it...? Ah, whenever I say that, they get up again...
(Bergelmir adjusts its position and sits down, a stark contrast to its aggressive stance a moment ago.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still alive...

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: '...You may lower your guard, guardian of this planet... The planetary reset was an error. The error has been fixed through debugging.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a lot of jargon. You mean we won't be fighting again?

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: '...Correct.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can I believe that?

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'I will cease functioning soon. Before that, I need to tell you the truth.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you put it that way, I'll listen.

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'Thank you, guardian. I will explain. I am Bergelmir, a weapon dispatched to destroy this place because it contained many evil beings.'

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: '...But Etoile is a good planet. Not evil. Bergelmir fought another evil that had come to destroy it.'

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'Then I fell into the forest and lost my memories. It would have been better not to awaken.'

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: '...I was glad to meet the villagers. Glad to meet Edda.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Edda...? The girl with those strange monster arms on her back? She attacked me, then disappeared. I followed her and ended up here.

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: '...That child has died. As she vanished, she thanked the planet's guardian. For helping Shynic, for destroying Ixion... for allowing her to escape the curse...'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic? Ixion? What does that mean? And what curse?

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'Edda escaped the curse through death. But she placed that same curse upon them: the humans who destroyed this forest's everyday life...'

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'Those humans received that power from him, just as the mage did. So did Edda. Edda's curse passed to the humans up ahead.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So... it's all the same curse? All the same power? What is this...?

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: '...He calls it binding...'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait. Binding... The power of binding?

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'They erected a giant energy stone and detonated it. People and other living beings were crystallized. Their power was transferred to another space...'

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'The suffering here was for Azrael...'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is Azrael? What could Azrael possibly be that you'd kill living beings for it?!

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'Kzzzt... kzzzt...'
(Static interferes with Bergelmir's voice, making it difficult to hear.)

lines.speaker: 베르겔미르
lines.text: 'Thank you, guardian of the planet. And...'
(Bergelmir suddenly rises and pushes %s aside. An ominous force flies in from somewhere, pierces Bergelmir's heart, and vanishes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This... this power...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Fragments of Bergelmir's shattered heart tumble to %s's feet.)
(Bergelmir shuts down and moves no more.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Unease settles over you. A feeling you've experienced before.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stay calm, %s... No need to overthink it... I only did what I had to do here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I tell Jin and leave the rest to the allied forces...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...First, get out of here. Stop talking nonsense. I-I should take a fragment of Bergelmir's heart...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Shh. Quiet...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Oh, that's...
(In the distance, you see a man in black armor and a red-haired man and woman.)
(You can't tell what is happening, but the armored man's gestures make the red-haired man cry out in pain.)

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Guh... Guh... A-aaaaaah!

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: S-stop! Let Ban go!

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Aaaaaah!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: You said you would accept the outcome when the time came. This is the outcome you have been given... You should have left this forest and that child alone.

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Wh-what are you talking about? Urgh, stop. I-I was wrong. Please... What did I do to you? I gave you the improved magic stones!

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: Gaaaaaaah!

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: S-stop! Stop it!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: A small vessel like you should have held only a little power. Foolish. You should have ended it, but you couldn't stop... That was your mistake.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Now disappear... into the deepest abyss...
(A vast opening suddenly appears behind the suffering Ban. Dozens, hundreds of black arms emerge and envelop him.)

lines.speaker: 반
lines.text: S-stop! I was wrong! P-please spare me!
(Ban's form grows faint, then scatters like smoke and disappears, as though he no longer exists in this world.)

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: B-Ban? Ban?!
(Witnessing the scene, Mara collapses to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 마라
lines.text: Dit, where are you...? B-Ban... Sob... sob...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I know you're there, %s... Come out now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Weiss... Wait, what's Jin doing?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jin? What are you doing?
(Jin tightens his grip on his sword, looking ready to charge at Weiss.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Jin. Stop.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Don't stop me. I... My kingdom... Because of the Deimos cult, Ban and Mara, those bastards... Urgh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't stay here, Jin. Join the allied forces. I'll find a way to handle this. Trust me and go back. Take this, too. Evidence from Oneiro Forest...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: All right. Then I'll leave the rest to you...
(Jin nods and hurries toward the allied forces.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: We have something to discuss. Not here, but on the reverse side...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The reverse side? W-wait... Where are you taking me?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is this? It's definitely Moros, but...

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Very well. I'll explain. As you saw, he returned to power that will be used where it is needed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Power used where it's needed? What have you done with thousands, tens of thousands of lives? And what is Azrael?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: ...You have no need to know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you think a life is worth?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I have something to give you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want me to accept something from an enemy? Are you out of your mind?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Power I acquired during my stay in Eastland... Call it a trace of a Champion's power.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I have no need of it. So I will give it to someone who does. To you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't need your power. The other Champions' power is enough! How am I supposed to know what you're giving me...?

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Heh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (At Weiss's scoff, the unease and strange sensations you felt in Coral City, Monster Tree Mountain, and Xerenis Magic Academy all return at once.)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Yes. This was something I—or he—planned long ago. How amusing that you doubted your own god.
(Weiss lifts his hand and moves it slightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A strange force approaches from somewhere and binds your entire body. The power you felt in Lapier, the fear you felt recently at the academy...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh... Aaaaaah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaaah!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: The power restraining you belongs entirely to me. But the power I'm giving you does not. Now you and I will each draw closer to our own 'end.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaah! S-stop it!
(Weiss opens his hand, and an unfamiliar sphere of light rises from it. Clear and beautiful, the violet sphere leaves his palm and moves toward %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Weiss's power is being a-absorbed into me.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But this... The traces of a Champion's power that Shynic and Atkina gave me... It feels just like that. Did he gain this power here?)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: So you recognize that this power is the same as theirs.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: Yes. The gods who loved this world left their power in Eastland. That power passed, undiminished, to those who had transcended humanity.

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: ...It would be a shame to let you go like this. I'll give you a little more pain. And tell you something else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaah! Guh... Wh-what could you... Gaaaaah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As Weiss smiles in satisfaction, pain continues surging through your body, as though engraving itself into you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: U-urgh! Aaaaaah!

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: I will be waiting at the 'end' you approach.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't make out what Weiss is saying...)

lines.speaker: 바이스
lines.text: And you will call him...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't hear Weiss's voice... I can't even see his face clearly...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Iris, I'm sorry...)

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Wake up, %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jin appears through your blurred vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jin... Where... Urgh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The pain of Weiss's power suddenly returns to your mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cough... cough... Ugh... Ugh...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: You priests! Over here, quickly!
(At Jin's call, priests hurry over. They examine the fallen %s and cast healing magic.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Why is this happening to me...?)

steps.name: The Fall of a Kingdom
steps.objective: Talk to [Jin] in front of [Dreaming Oneiro] in "Moros", then find [Dayna] in "Esnil".

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Thank goodness. You don't have any serious injuries...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it... Is everything here over now...?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Everything in Moros is finished. The allied forces will handle the rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you tell anyone you saw Weiss here? Oh, what about the golem? What did you do with the heart fragment?

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Sigh. I really don't understand you. You could find that out later.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: All right, I'll tell you. I haven't told anyone I saw Weiss. No—I won't tell anyone.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I'll hold on to the heart fragment, then entrust it to a Jewel School mage.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: As for Mara, the Silvaria Empire will interrogate her directly. The Kingdom of Jude has its own score to settle, but that will come later.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: Does that answer your questions?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you. I'm fine now. I don't need any more healing.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: You do seem better, but don't push yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm going back to rest now.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I can arrange a place in Lumen. Why not rest there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. If I go back, I'll get in Iris's way... There's somewhere I can go in Freios. I'll head there.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: I don't know what awaits you, but I hope nothing else goes wrong.

lines.speaker: 진
lines.text: And come see me in Lumen when you have time. There's something I'd like to discuss.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something has definitely changed. My mind feels clearer because of the power Weiss gave me... This is certainly a trace of a Champion's power.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, I don't know anymore. I'll go see Dayna first... Then do nothing for a while...)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank goodness, %s...
(Dayna embraces you, worry written across her face.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Are you all right? You're not hurt anywhere?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly tell Dayna what happened in Moros.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: ...Thank goodness. I can't say it enough. Thank goodness...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sigh... That sister of mine finally gets in touch, only to give me a task like this. Making me play the villain who sends an innocent person into danger.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: ...Sorry. Just talking to myself. Don't mind me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rather loudly, for talking to yourself. But have you been somewhere? You're wounded...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: While you were there, %s, we had work of our own to do.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We tracked down the groups looking for a weak point to exploit and taught them a lesson. Sigh... Anyway, you've worked hard. Let the Empire's higher-ups handle the trouble for a while. Get some rest...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you. This world owes you another debt.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: So I'll be counting on you in the future, too. We may end up owing you again. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. I suppose so. Thinking that this isn't the end makes me feel trapped all over again.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There are so many things I should thank you for... I only found out afterward that you helped my younger sister, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your younger sister?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, at Xerenis Magic Academy. The student council president, Shiina, is my younger sister. Shiina Dawn Silvaria.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I thought you looked alike. Wait, what? ...Dun Silvaria? I've heard that name... When I received Her Majesty's decree...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Huh? You've come all this way, and you didn't know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I-I really didn't.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Oh, judging by your face, you really had no idea. Sigh... Ahahaha! Honestly, that sister of mine... Ugh, never mind. You look tired, %s. Go rest at the guild inn. Ahahahaha...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'll have plenty of Zellic's cooking sent over. Eat and rest, all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. All right. Let's talk later.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes, later... Whenever that is. Come see me again when you feel like talking about anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I'll head to the inn.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (With Dayna pushing you along, it seems best to leave quickly.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sigh. This is why I hate getting involved with my sister. Still, it can't be helped. She's part of the reason I'm alive like this.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And now it's time...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Well, thank you for waiting.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Mr. Kazno.
(The person called Kazno slowly steps out of the dark shadows deeper in the city.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We've found the part of the snake Mr. Jeril asked about. Zisk Territory, in Eastland. That's the place.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I'm in your debt...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Well, my sister probably knows already, so I suppose it doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I will keep my promise.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Much appreciated. Still, I'm envious. Using Agasura contracts as a reason to rely on people everywhere...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Oh, he's gone already. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Then I should get some rest too. And prepare, since there's no telling what will happen next...
